title: Adaptive Grid Refinement for Optimal Feedback Control
summary: This paper introduces an algorithmic approach for adaptive grid refinement for solving the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) partial differential equation (PDE) to obtain the optimal feedback control. Traditional grid generation methods often face challenges associated with state-space dimensionality, solution regularity, and large variations in the solution.
